name: Discord
description: Read channels and messages of a Discord server and post messages, as your own bot. It can never delete, kick, ban or change roles. The second permission is only for showing people's profile pictures.
author: Lily

settings.name: token
settings.label: Bot token
settings.description: The token of your own Discord bot (developer portal, Bot page). What it can see and post is decided by the bot's role in the server.

tools.name: discord_list_channels
tools.description: List the channels of a server (names and ids) that the bot is in.

tools.name: discord_read_messages
tools.description: Read the newest 10 messages of a channel. Needs the Message Content intent turned on for the bot.

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.description: Post a message in a channel as the bot. Asks you every time. It cannot ping @everyone, @here or roles.

params.name: content
params.description: The message text, 2000 characters at most.
